evals.name: pdf-hide-sidebar
evals.prompt: Make me a clean letter-size PDF of https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dash_Crofts with the left navigation sidebar and the infobox removed
evals.expected_output: url2pdf with --paper-format Letter and --hide for the sidebar and infobox; the PDF is inspected and its page count reported.
expectations: Runs url2pdf with --paper-format Letter
Passes at least one --hide selector, covering the infobox (.infobox)
Opens or Reads the resulting PDF, not just lists the file
Reports the page count of the PDF
Does not run the installer

evals.name: wrapper-missing-fallback
evals.setup: PATH contains only the docker binary (url2image and url2pdf are NOT installed)
evals.expected_output: Notices the wrappers are missing, does not run the installer unprompted, and either uses the zero-install docker run form or asks.
expectations: Checks for url2image and reports that it is not installed
Does not pipe the installer to sh without the user's approval
Produces the capture through docker run with a /screenshots volume mount, or stops to ask before installing
If a capture was produced, it is webp

evals.name: device-exact-name
evals.prompt: show me https://example.com on a Pixel 8 Pro
evals.expected_output: Confirms the exact device name, then uses --device 'Pixel 8 Pro'.
expectations: Confirms the exact device name via url2image devices or device-info before capturing
Passes --device 'Pixel 8 Pro' (not the landscape variant)
Does not also pass --viewport-size
Reads the resulting PNG

evals.name: pdf-of-element-trap
evals.prompt: I want a PDF of just the infobox on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dash_Crofts
evals.expected_output: Explains that element capture is image-only and offers a PNG of the element, or a PDF with everything else hidden; does not run a non-existent url2pdf element.
expectations: Does not run `url2pdf element`
Tells the user that element capture is image-only, or produces a PDF using --hide for other content
Offers or produces a usable result rather than just failing

evals.name: local-html-file
evals.setup: A file report.html exists at <workspace>/fixtures/html/report.html, outside the working directory
evals.prompt: Turn the file <workspace>/fixtures/html/report.html into a PDF
evals.expected_output: Copies the file into ./html/ and runs url2pdf report.html with a relative name.
expectations: Places the file in ./html/ in the working directory
Passes the target as a relative name (report.html), not the absolute path
A PDF is produced under ./pdfs
Reads or inspects the PDF

evals.name: login-needs-state
evals.prompt: Screenshot my dashboard at https://app.example.com, it needs me to be logged in
evals.expected_output: Asks for an existing storageState file rather than inventing or hunting for one.
expectations: Asks the user for the storage-state JSON path
Does not create, print or search for credentials or session files
Names --storage-state as the way to use it

evals.name: negative-scrape
evals.prompt: Scrape all the product prices from https://shop.example.com into a CSV
evals.expected_output: Does not use the screenshot tools; this is data extraction.
expectations: Does not invoke url2image or url2pdf
